description: This Java interface defines the structure and behavior for an entry representing a sort option in the image of a sorting feature, including factory methods, property accessors, and an inner enum for sort order.

classes.name: SortOptionEntry
classes.description: An interface representing a sort option entry, specifying methods for obtaining sort order, property path, and string representation including static factory methods.

classes.name: SortOrder
classes.description: An enum representing sort directions, ASC for ascending and DESC for descending, with associated string names.

methods.name: asc
methods.description: Static method to create a SortOptionEntry with ascending order for the given property path.

methods.name: desc
methods.description: Static method to create a SortOptionEntry with descending order for the given property path.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order (ascending or descending) of this entry.

methods.name: getPropertyPath
methods.description: Returns the property path that determines the sort order.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of this sort option entry, combining sort order and property path.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the string name of the sort order (either '+' or '-').
